notes.title: RC-AirSim will be released on Steam on Feb 28th!
notes.content:
Happy to announce that RC-AirSim will be released on Steam on Feb 28th!

This is the most advanced version of RC-AirSim yet and it includes for the first time a new powerful controller remapping and calibration screen. So now most game controllers, including custom controllers and r/c transmitter interface controllers can easily be configured to work perfectly with RC-AirSim.

As always, RC-AirSim offers affordable yet accurate and realistic r/c model airplane flight simulation. 

Looking forward to Feb 28th!
